name: cvfit
title_zh: 对着招聘启事逐条改简历的排版工
tagline_zh: 把职位描述拆成关键词清单，你的经历挨个对照着改。投完这份，下一份还得重新来一遍——它只认当前这一个坑。
tagline_en: Feeds the posting's keywords into your work history, line by line. One application only — next job, redo it all.
desc_en: Use when someone points at a job, hackathon, fellowship or program application and wants a resume for it. Triggers: a posting URL, a screenshot of a posting, pasted posting text, a company plus role name, or phrasings like 'adapt my CV to this', 'tailor my resume for this role', 'Harvard format resume', 'make a CV for this application', 'one-page resume'. The skill reads the posting, assembles the
why_zh: 不是模板填空，是拿招聘原文当标尺，逐条量你的经历缺口。改完的简历像对着镜子裁的衣服。
why_en: It uses the job ad itself as the ruler, measuring each bullet against their exact asks. You get a resume that mirrors their.
limit_zh: 只吃英文岗位描述，产出单页PDF。不负责写新经历，你原本没有的它编不出来。中文简历、学术CV、非程序类申请直接罢工。
limit_en: English job posts only; outputs one-page PDF. Won't invent experience you lack. Chinese resumes, academic CVs, non-program roles: it stops cold.
title_en: A resume tailor that rewrites line by line against the job.
